title: Delhi ka loha stambh: 1,600 saal, phir bhi zang nahi!
source: Wikipedia · Britannica · Down to Earth (IIT Kanpur) · IUPAC · Delhi Tourism

captions.instagram:
Ye lohe ka khamba 1,600 saal se dhoop-baarish mein khada hai, aur zang se kharab nahi hua 🏛️

🔩 Raaz: iske lohe mein zyada phosphorus, jo upar ek patli si parat bana deta hai. Aur ye ek saanche mein nahi dhala, garam lohe ke tukdon ko peet-peet kar joda gaya tha!

Sources: Wikipedia, Britannica, Down to Earth (IIT Kanpur research), IUPAC, Delhi Tourism.
Photo: 03Ani03 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Facts checked:
• The iron pillar stands in the Qutb complex, Mehrauli, Delhi, and is about 7.2 m tall — Wikipedia
• Made in the Gupta period about 1,600 years ago; its oldest inscription names a king Chandra, generally identified as Chandragupta II — Wikipedia; Britannica
• It rusts only very slightly: a thin protective layer keeps corrosion minimal — Wikipedia; IUPAC
• High phosphorus in the iron helps form the thin protective layer (Balasubramaniam, IIT Kanpur) — Down to Earth; IUPAC; Britannica
• Made by forge welding: hot pieces of wrought iron hammered together, not cast — Wikipedia; Britannica
• Visitors used to hug it for wishes; a fence was put around it in 1997 — Delhi Tourism; Culture Trip
